description: This file defines a static class 'ConsistentRingInstruments' that registers metrics instruments related to a consistent hashing ring, including ring size, local ring percentage, and average ring percentage, for diagnostics and telemetry purposes.

classes.name: ConsistentRingInstruments
classes.description: A static internal class for registering and managing diagnostic gauge instruments related to a consistent ring.

methods.name: RegisterRingSizeObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the ring size, using a callback to observe the current ring size.

methods.name: RegisterMyRangeRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the local ring percentage, using a callback to observe the current percentage.

methods.name: RegisterAverageRingPercentageObserve
methods.description: Registers an observable gauge for the average ring percentage, using a callback to observe the current value.
